title: Benadir-administered Mogadishu rally condemning the Dec 28 al-Shabaab bombing
notes: Horn Observer dates the rally to Jan 2, 2020. It was organized by Benadir administration and primarily condemned al-Shabaab; Sitata's separate road-closure alert confirms only a scheduled rally and its captured text omits the year. Do not treat it as a Jan 2021 protest.

title: Mogadishu demonstration against outgoing President Farmaajo and for a free election
notes: Garowe Online reports a large gathering across several Mogadishu districts on Feb 9, outside this month. It also includes a participant's allegation about recruits sent to Eritrea; no January onset or physical continuity is established.

title: Mogadishu parents' protest over sons missing after Eritrea training
notes: Goobjooge reports a public demonstration in Mogadishu on May 16, 2021. The article describes a longstanding complaint but does not establish continuous physical action or a direct link to the Jan 20 Galkayo gathering.

title: Mogadishu opposition protest against delays to the national election
notes: The National reports a small crowd demonstrating on Feb19 over election delay, outside January. It is unrelated to the missing-recruits parent actions; no physical continuity between the two issues is established.

title: Federal and Jubbaland forces clash in Bulo Hawo
notes: AP reports armed fighting between federal and Jubbaland forces, with no public protest gathering or protest demand described.

title: Mogadishu opposition protest over delayed elections
notes: The opened Garowe Online article is dated Dec15, 2020 and reports an opposition protest over election delays. It is not the missing-recruits grievance and does not establish physical continuity into January.

title: Galkayo demonstration against Al-Shabaab
notes: Garowe Online reports hundreds in Galkayo rallying against Al-Shabaab and supporting Somali forces, outside January. The article does not describe an explicit government-policy demand.

title: Mogadishu parents protest to bring recruits home from Eritrea
notes: Keydmedia reports a later demonstration in July 2022. It is a separate dated action; no evidence of continuous physical protest from January 2021 is reported.
